messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: metering.emit.backfill_latency > 30m in eu-west-1 (alert id: ALRT-5938). Shadow vs primary counts diverging; overage flag rate increased. dashboard: https://lake.redwood.internal/d/emit/backfill-latency
oncall-jordan: I'm on it. seeing alarm, pulling quick metrics. Maria, are we already running any scheduled backfills? :eyes:
maria-billing: Not scheduled this window. Only the nightly compact backfill (00:30 UTC) finished earlier. No manual replays I'm aware of.
sam-sre: Can you paste the alert graph? I want to check emitter queue depth and consumer lag. Also running a quick query against the event ledger.
leo-eng: Noted, I'll check the emitter partition consumer offsets and recent commit rates.
ops-bot: Deployment notice: deploy/emit-backfill-worker v3.4.1 rolled at 2026-03-12T02:01Z for eu clusters.
oncall-jordan: quick SQL to compare emitted vs ingested counts for last hour:
```sql
SELECT source, count(*) AS emitted FROM usage_events
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY source;
SELECT source, count(*) AS ingested FROM billing_ledger
WHERE event_time >= NOW() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY source;
```
maria-billing: SQL shows ~180k emitted, but ledger has ~132k for same window. ~48k missing. That explains some overage flags because shadow aggregate is lower.
sam-sre: Any errors in emitter logs? tailing last 200 lines from backfill worker group:
```
[2026-03-12T02:15:21Z] ERROR: commit failed on partition 7: timeout
[2026-03-12T02:15:22Z] WARN: retrying emit for batch 4521 (size 1024)
[2026-03-12T02:15:25Z] INFO: acked batch 4521 after 3 retries
[2026-03-12T02:16:03Z] ERROR: emitter client rechoke, backpressure high
```
leo-eng: Those timeout/retries can inflate emitted counters if the emitter increments before final ack. Looks like duplicate emission path didn't dedupe on retries.
maria-billing: Customer impact check: billing-alerts fired for ~12 tenants (high-volume) with temporary overage flagging. No invoices generated yet but flags visible in console.
oncall-jordan: Immediate mitigation: pause backfill worker queue for eu-west-1 and enable safe-debounce on emitter for retry dedupe. I'll run the playbook commands.
sam-sre: Commands to pause backfill:
```
# pause backfill queue
kubectl -n emit scale deployment/backfill-worker-eu --replicas=0
# enable debounce (feature flag)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/flags/emitter_dedupe -d '{"enabled":true}'
```
ops-bot: runbook step executed by oncall-jordan: paused backfill-worker-eu. feature flag toggle queued.
oncall-jordan: Flag toggle successful. Monitoring for duplicate increments to fall. Checking shadow vs primary counts again.
maria-billing: After pause + dedupe, gap reduced to ~2.1k within 6 minutes. Overflag rate down to baseline. Customers still see flags but flagged_count is decaying.
leo-eng: We'll keep backfill paused and run a controlled reemit with dedupe on a staging subset, then resume at controlled rate.
maria-billing: Customer comms: draft posted to #customer-ops: "We observed transient meter count divergence in EU resulting in temporary overage flags for a subset of high-volume tenants. We paused a background backfill and applied safeguards. No invoices were charged. Working on a reconciliation and will follow up." Ready to send if agreed. :email:
sam-sre: Agree. Add note to credit any customers that were erroneously flagged if post-recon confirms false positives.
oncall-jordan: Escalating to billing-eng for deeper root cause and follow-up ticket. Creating INC ticket: INC-2026-5938 (emit-retry-dedupe). Maria, please list impacted tenants in ticket.
maria-billing: Added tenant list and preliminary delta numbers to INC-2026-5938. Also attached timeline and raw SQL outputs.
leo-eng: Follow-up action items: 1) fix emitter idempotency on retry path (PR in progress), 2) add metric that measures ack vs increment discrepancy, 3) scheduled replay with dedupe offload.
oncall-jordan: Handoff to next oncall in 20m — leaving notes in incident channel and setting L1 monitor to watch counts for 60m.
ops-bot: Reminder: incident call in 15m (bridge r/ops-link).
maria-billing: I'll prepare post-incident reconciliation runbook and draft customer emails for confirmed false positives.
oncall-jordan: Thanks all — mitigation in place, customer impact limited, follow-ups created. Leaving channel. :white_check_mark:
leo-eng: I'll shepherd the emitter PR and test in staging, will ping when ready to re-enable backfill at 10% capacity first.
sam-sre: Good job. We should include this case in monthly metering postmortems (note: duplicate increment on retry).
ops-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Closing pager.
